x-comment: Flathub's manifest: the release build of a tagged version (FLATHUB.md).
Permissions, and why: docs/decisions.md ('The Flatpak sees the usual places; the file
chooser grants the rest'). network: Open Library, OPDS catalogues, KOReader sync, Send to
Kindle (SMTP), Look Up, Library Sharing's server (and Calibre's lock, an abstract socket).
~/Books: the library folder, made when missing. Documents, ~/Calibre Library: where
people keep books and Calibre libraries, read in place (written by Keep Calibre in Step,
trashed by Move to Trash). Downloads, read only: the welcome counts e-books there, which
are copied in. ~/.config/calibre: Calibre's record of where its library is. stardict:
offline dictionaries for Look Up. /run/media, /media, gvfs: e-readers on USB and MTP, and
their eject. speech-dispatcher: Read Aloud through the host's daemon. Avahi: Library
Sharing advertised on the network. Any other folder (a watched folder, a Calibre library
elsewhere, another library folder) comes through the file chooser portal, which keeps
the grant. The keyring is libsecret's Secret portal.
The GNOME runtime has WebKitGTK 6, PyGObject, pycairo, libsecret, bsdtar (CBR) and
blueprint-compiler 0.22; Poppler, lxml and speechd's client are built here.
